$schema_note: Critical-path e2e contract. Middle ground: not every click, but every user-visible capability we ship must keep a named check. Epics add rows when they land a vertical slice.

context.note: Fingerprint of the domain context this contract was last reviewed against. When CONTEXT.md or docs/adr change, review the rows below against the new capabilities, then restamp: node test/app/coverage-contract.mjs --stamp

paths.user_action: See brand welcome and nearest-World offer
paths.check: the welcome gate shows brand, pitch, and nearest-park on one card

paths.user_action: Confirm nearest World and load its map
paths.check: the nearest-park button asks before building that park

paths.user_action: Set rider height and see who can ride
paths.check: verdicts respond to height

paths.user_action: Preview a walk then Start
paths.check: Start hands the screen over to the walk

paths.user_action: Walk toward destination and see remaining distance drop
paths.check: walking towards it shortens what is left

paths.user_action: Route preview names surveyed queue entrances (Cedar Point)
paths.check: cedar point route preview names surveyed queue entrances

paths.user_action: Start a party and get a shareable code
paths.check: party code is six characters from the safe alphabet

paths.user_action: Join a party by typing the code
paths.check: a typed code joins the party

paths.user_action: Join a party from the invite link
paths.check: the invite link joins the party with nothing typed

paths.user_action: NEED HELP reaches other phones
paths.check: NEED HELP propagates to the other phone

paths.user_action: Host leaves and party survives
paths.check: a new host is elected without anybody being asked

paths.user_action: Every shipped venue sits inside App Store routing coverage
paths.check: App Store routing coverage includes every shipped venue

paths.user_action: Map still draws offline
paths.check: the map still draws with the network cut

paths.user_action: Cached Profile identity (name, offline cue, rank title) shows on Settings with no network and no live session
paths.check: offline profile identity survives without network

paths.user_action: First-time visitor can complete toilet → food → walk
Anonymous can start a Party by name; Profile still gates Side Quest submit
paths.check: anonymous can start a party by name

paths.user_action: Sign in or Guest from the Profile gate; Google/Apple on /sign-in
paths.check: Profile gate shows Sign in and Guest

paths.user_action: Add a device-less Member with height to the Party roster
paths.check: device-less Members can be added to the roster

paths.user_action: Submit or discover a Side Quest nearby
paths.check: Side Quest submit queues locally

paths.user_action: A queued Side Quest reaches the server once the network is back
paths.check: queued Side Quest syncs once the network is back

paths.user_action: Complete a gap Side Quest and see Overlay on this phone
paths.check: complete a gap quest draws Overlay on the map

paths.user_action: See structured eligibility reason on a ride
paths.check: ride detail shows a structured eligibility reason

paths.user_action: See a visible Unknown verdict on a ride with no height data, instead of a blank badge
paths.check: ride with no height data shows an Unknown verdict

paths.user_action: Next-best GO NOW + Why?
paths.check: GO NOW card carries a Why? explanation

paths.user_action: A ride report old enough to hedge is visibly muted and never claims live/GO NOW
paths.check: a stale report is marked and never claims live/GO NOW

paths.user_action: Switch to Precise sharing for 30 minutes; it reverts to Approximate on its own
paths.check: precise sharing expires back to approximate

paths.user_action: Height, theme, and party survive a reload

paths.check: Rally Point set from a ride reaches the other phone

paths.user_action: Retract a Ride report and it clears everywhere
